subject.title: Cron jobs stall during AI model calls (model_call:stream_progress never completes)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for both main-session `systemEvent` delivery and immediate-wake result semantics, or should the wake contract become a separate issue while this one is narrowed to event delivery?
rationale: The merged lifecycle work appears to resolve the headline isolated-stream liveness problem, but the remaining reports span two different cron boundaries with different owners, tests, and user-visible contracts.

options.title: Narrow this issue and split wake reporting
options.body: Keep this issue for main-session event delivery, and open or designate a separate canonical report for immediate-wake completion semantics.

options.title: Retain the combined cron contract tracker
options.body: Keep both gaps together until source-level reproduction shows they share one enqueue-to-heartbeat failure path.

recommendation.title: Narrow this issue and split wake reporting
recommendation.body: Keep this issue for main-session event delivery, and open or designate a separate canonical report for immediate-wake completion semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent lifecycle status already distinguishes the resolved stream-stall work from the remaining wake-result gap.
